driver noun

classical

L&S

raedārius, raedāriī m.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

driver of a raeda

Other words

  • autoraedārius — car driver

    also used · modern · Traupman 165, 216; Traupman 217: motorist; Traupman 289; Traupman 307 · Wiktionary

  • autocīnētistēs, autocīnētistae m. — a motorist, a driver

    noun, first declension · also used · modern · Traupman 216, 217 · Declension on Wiktionary

Examples

  • Pater in sēde anteriōre cum raedāriō fābulābātur

    Dad sat in the front seat chatting with the driverLibellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

See also drive, taxi, car.
